title: SSC CGL Tier-1 Full Length Mock Test 20
description: Hard Level full length mock test for SSC CGL Tier-1 covering Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English and General Awareness. Total 100 questions, 60 minutes.
instructions: There is a negative marking of 0.5 marks for each wrong answer.
Use of calculator is not allowed.
Do not refresh the page during the test.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Select the related word/letters/number from the given alternatives. Book : Author :: Painting : ?
questions.explanation: A book is created by an author; similarly, a painting is created by an artist.

questions.explanation: Earth is the only planet with life; others are not known to support life.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain code, 'COMPUTER' is written as 'RFUVQNPC'. How is 'PRINTER' written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is reversed and then +1. P-R-I-N-T-E-R reversed is R-E-T-N-I-R-P, then +1: S-F-U-O-J-S-Q.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'I have no brother or sister but that man's father is my father's son.' Whose photograph was it?
questions.explanation: My father's son is myself. So that man's father is myself. Hence, it is his son's photograph.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 5 km towards South and then turns to the right. After walking 3 km he turns to the left and walks 5 km. Now in which direction is he from the starting place?
questions.explanation: South 5 km, right (West) 3 km, left (South) 5 km. Net: South 10 km, West 3 km → South-West.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All roses are flowers. Some flowers are red. Conclusions: I. Some roses are red. II. All red are flowers.
questions.explanation: Neither conclusion necessarily follows from the given statements.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A, B, C, D, E are sitting in a row. A is to the left of B but right of C. D is between A and B. Who is sitting in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order: C, A, D, B, E or similar. D is between A and B, so D is in the middle of the group of three.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which of the following diagrams indicates the best relation between Travellers, Train and Bus?
options: One circle inside another with a separate one
questions.explanation: Some travellers use train, some use bus, some use both, some use neither.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If a mirror is placed on the line MN, then which of the answer figures is the right image of the given figure? (Assume standard mirror image question for a letter)

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a class of 40 students, Ravi ranks 15th from the top. What is his rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Rank from bottom = Total - Rank from top + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Input: 25 32 47 58 63. Step I: 63 25 32 47 58. What is the next step?

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.explanation: Transitive property: All dogs are animals and all animals are living beings, so all dogs are living beings.
